name: Sea surface temperature, WOA23 1991–2020 climate normal, monthly on 1°

source.dataset: World Ocean Atlas 2023, objectively analyzed temperature (t_an), period decav91C0 (1991–2020), 1.00° csv form
references: Locarnini et al. 2023, WOA23 Volume 1: Temperature, NOAA Atlas NESDIS 89

period: 1991–2020, months 01–12 (centered on the middle of each month of a 365-day year)
mask: WOA's own: land, ice shelves and cells without an analysis are missing
definition: °C at 0 m; the file data/references/woa23-sst-1991-2020.bin in the 'WOAM' layout of scripts/packWoaMonthlySst.py (decodeMonthlySst in js/ocean/climatology.module.js; scripts/woaSstBias.mjs --woa). The model's matching quantity is the day-mean sst of sea cells deeper than 1 m. The atlas's 'decav' (data/woa_sst_monthly_1deg.bin) averages its decades and sits 0.20 K below this normal over 30S–30N, 0.32 K in the cold tongue (2S–2N, 150–90W) and 0.16 K in the warm pool (10S–10N, 130–160E).
